column1: Scenario: The Ministry wants to prepare a clear and professionally presented renewable energy report containing information about Indian States/UTs.
1. Select the column headings using keyboard shortcuts and apply suitable formatting to highlight them.
2. Adjust the column widths and row heights to ensure all content is clearly visible.
3. Select the entire dataset using keyboard shortcuts and apply borders.
4. Select the data entries using keyboard shortcuts and apply a suitable font size.
5. Freeze the top row using keyboard shortcuts so that the column headings remain visible while scrolling.
